text:
Flatpak support has been successfully added to the proprietary software scanner. The implementation includes:

**New Features:**
- Flatpak package manager detection
- Scanning of both Flatpak applications and runtime packages
- Automatic inclusion of Flatpak directories in filesystem scanning
- Extended proprietary package database with Flatpak application IDs

**Key Changes:**
- Added `flatpak` to package manager detection
- Implemented `_scan_flatpak_packages()` method
- Added Flatpak-specific directories to filesystem scanning
- Updated configuration with common Flatpak application IDs
- Enhanced documentation with Flatpak-specific information

**Flatpak Application IDs Added:**
- `com.google.Chrome`, `com.slack.Slack`, `com.spotify.Client`
- `com.discordapp.Discord`, `com.valvesoftware.Steam`
- `com.microsoft.Teams`, `com.microsoft.Edge`
- `com.visualstudio.code`, `com.skype.Client`, `com.zoom.Zoom`

The tool now automatically detects and scans Flatpak installations alongside traditional package managers, providing comprehensive proprietary software detection across all major Linux packaging systems.
